subject: mathematics
concept: Classifying angles as acute, right, obtuse, straight, or reflex
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student adjusts a virtual angle-tester tool and names the resulting angle type
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts pictured angles into their correct category
exercise.abstract: Student classifies a given angle measure (in degrees) into its category

misconception_flags: misjudges angle size purely by the drawn line length

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
